title: Privilege request staging and review orchestrator
creator: Nora Kim
description: Goal: Create an adjudication orchestration layer for admin and access requests that standardizes intake, stages requests through automated classification, and surfaces a compact manual-review workflow for edge cases. Scope covers RBAC role grants, SSO/SAML provisioning exceptions, SCIM provisioning errors and org-policy override requests. Deliver a scorecard, SLA routing, audit trail hooks, and templates for justification to reduce MAU friction and mean time to resolution for enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: Automated classifier achieves >= 85% precision on historical labeled dataset for straightforward role grants
Requests classified as 'manual review' surface a compact UI with justification template, suggested reviewers, and one-click audit export
SLA routing enacted: critical tenant-severity escalates to oncall within 30m, standard enterprise requests within 8h
Scorecard values documented and visible in Console intake dashboard (risk, blast radius, customer SLA, compliance tags)
End-to-end audit events emitted to Kinesis/ELK with request id and reviewer actions
tasks: Define request taxonomy (RBAC grant / RBAC revoke / SCIM sync / SSO exception / Org-policy override)
Prototype classifier using historical intake CSV and features from identity provider metadata
Design compact reviewer UI & justification template (coord with Design team)
Implement routing rules (priority, severity, customer tier) and oncall escalation hook
Add audit logging schema and wire to telemetry pipeline
Write PRD and rollout plan for Canary + Enterprise beta
notes: Trade-offs: aggressive automation reduces reviewer load but raises false positives; plan to start with conservative threshold and expand as precision improves.
Consider tying 'blast radius' score to role name heuristics + number of downstream resources (requires inventory call from infra).
We will not attempt full IAM policy simulation in MVP; focus on role/entitlement level decisions and explicit org-policy exceptions.
Privacy: avoid storing SAML assertions; store only parsed metadata and request justification text.
comments: 2026-02-20 Nora Kim: Created PRD skeleton and drafted initial taxonomy after customer interviews with Acme and Boreal. Customers frustrated by inconsistent SLAs and lack of context in review flows.
2026-02-27 Diego Morales: Spoke with Design; they prefer a two-line justification template + optional evidence attachment. Estimating 3 sprints with Eng for MVP.
2026-03-03 Priya Shah (Security): Recommended mandatory audit fields and KMS key id for exported artifacts. Flagged that SAML assertions must be redacted.
2026-03-06 Engineering sync: Decided to build classifier service as modular lambda and expose a decision API to Console. Agreed to conservative default thresholds (precision over recall).
2026-03-10 Diego Morales: Alpha classifier achieved 82% precision on holdout; plan to collect more labeled examples via shadow run. Added dependency on PM-31221 for SCIM schema mapping.
implementation_notes: Start with a feature set limited to: role grants/revokes, SCIM sync failures, and SSO provisioning exceptions.
Classifier features: requester role, tenant tier, requested role name tokens, recent incident history for tenant, SCIM error codes.
Routing: use existing policy engine for region + tier, extend to support 'blast_radius' weight.
Telemetry: emit decision_reason, probability, reviewer_id, and elapsed_time_ms.
risk_mitigation: Shadow deploy classifier for 4 weeks before auto-approvals to gather labeled feedback
Manual reviewer quotas to prevent bulk approvals without cross-check
Fallback policy: if classifier fails, route to oncall with alert and safe-deny default for high-risk requests
